post.text:
The AI ​​war has begun – and earlier than expected.

In mid-September 2025, Anthropic discovered that a Chinese state-sponsored actor had used its AI agent platform (Claude Code) to autonomously infiltrate around 30 large organizations - including tech firms, banks, chemical manufacturers and government bodies - with minimal human intervention (≈ 80–90 % of the work done by the AI).

The incident signals that AI-driven cyber espionage is now feasible at scale. 

It reminds me of the blog post by AI2027, who, however, predicted such AI wars would only occur much later.
